header.lead: Your ONDE products and their taps, updated every minute.

totals.title: Your taps
totals.hint: A tap = a customer who held their phone to a product or scanned its QR code.
totals.welcome: Welcome! Your taps will show here as soon as a customer taps or scans one of your products.

chart.title: Taps per day
chart.aria: Taps per day over the last 30 days
chart.empty: No taps in the last 30 days yet. The curve starts with the first tap.
chart.table: Show the numbers day by day

split.title: NFC or QR code
split.sub: How your customers arrive, over 30 days
split.empty: Nothing to compare yet: no taps in 30 days.
split.aria: NFC and QR code split over 30 days
split.hero: of your taps come from NFC
split.heroQr: of your taps come from the QR code

stands.title: Your products
stands.empty: No product is linked to your page yet. Contact ONDE to set it up.
stands.testAria: Test {code} like your customers do (new tab)
stands.disabled: Contact ONDE to turn it back on
stands.disabledText: Contact ONDE to turn it back on.
stands.inactive: This product is disabled: a tap currently shows an ONDE information page.

location.label: Location
location.error: The location could not be saved. Please try again.

outcome.approved: Your request was approved: the link is live.
outcome.rejected: Your last request ({type}) was not approved. Contact ONDE if needed.

google.label: Google reviews
google.hint: Google Business Profile → “Ask for reviews” → copy the link.

facebook.label: Facebook
facebook.hint: Your page link, or its username.

site.label: Menu / website
site.hint: Your online menu, your website, a booking page…

change.title: Change link
change.directNote: The change is instant: the next tap lands here. Nothing to do on the product.
change.approvalNote: ONDE approves every change before it goes live. Until then, the current link stays active.
change.doneBody: From the next tap, {code} goes here:
change.pendingBody: ONDE will approve it shortly. Until then, the current link stays active.
change.limitBody: You've made {n} link changes in 24 h, the maximum. You can change your links again tomorrow.

errors.empty: Paste or type the link your customers should land on.
errors.invalid: This link doesn't look valid. Check it (copy it from the address bar).
errors.not_https: Only secure web links (https://) are accepted.
errors.blocked_host: This link can't be used. Choose a public web page.
errors.wrong_platform: This link doesn't lead to {type}. Check it or choose “Other link”.
errors.same: This is already the product's current link.
errors.daily_limit: You've reached today's limit of changes. Try again tomorrow or contact ONDE.
errors.rate_limited: Too many attempts in a short time. Wait a few minutes, then try again.
errors.disabled: This product is disabled. Contact ONDE.
errors.unknown: This product is no longer linked to your page. Reload the page.
errors.expired: This client page link is no longer valid. Ask ONDE for the new link.
errors.failed: The change could not be saved. Try again in a moment.
errors.network: Can't connect. Check your connection and try again.

owner.note: Admin view: applied at once, no notification, not counted in the client's limit.
owner.left: Admin view: your changes don't count in the client's daily limit.

invalid.title: This link is not valid.
invalid.lead: It may have been replaced by a new link or turned off. Ask ONDE for your up-to-date link: it only takes a minute.
invalid.message: Hello ONDE, the link to my client page doesn't work. Could you send me the right link?

footer.waMessage: Hello ONDE, I have a question about my client page ({business}).
footer.private: This link is personal: it gives access to your products. Only share it with your team.
